homeSeoDescription: VocabBuilder helps you practice words, translations, grammar, and learning progress in one focused vocabulary app.
homeHeroTitle: Build a vocabulary habit that actually sticks.
homeHeroDescription: Practice words in a focused dictionary, keep translations and grammar notes together, and see progress without losing momentum.
homePreviewDescription: A focused view of what you are learning now.
homeFeatureDescription1: Keep vocabulary, translation, grammar, and progress in one interface built for daily use.
homeFeatureDescription2: Scan what needs attention and return to the words that are still not stable.
homeFeatureDescription3: Track learning status without complex dashboards or distracting metrics.
registrationSeoDescription: Create your VocabBuilder account to start practicing vocabulary and tracking your progress.
registrationDescription: To start using our services, please fill out the registration form below. All fields are mandatory:
name: Name
validationNameMin: Name must contain at least 2 characters.
validationPasswordInvalid: The password must consist of 6 English letters and 1 number.

loginDescription: Please enter your login details to continue using our service:
dictionarySeoDescription: Review your saved words, translations, grammar notes, and vocabulary learning progress.
